name: sumi-kaze
vibe: a Japanese sumi-e ink-wash scroll come alive: warm washi paper with enormous negative space, translucent sumi mountain ridges drifting in parallax, horizontal mist bands and falling vermillion petals; headlines dragged on by a loaded brush stroke, scene changes as blooming ink blots, and the emphasis word stamped with a vermillion hanko seal — calm, poetic launches, brand films and story pieces that should feel hand-painted

assets.photoMod: sumi-e ink wash painting muted zen minimal japanese

sfx.style: soft brush swishes, ink drops, a single wooden stamp thud on the seal, distant wind chimes — sparse, contemplative, landing with the ink blots
